brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of XW003 injection in Chinese adolescents with obesity
brief_title: A Study of XW003 Injection in Chinese Adolescents With Obesity
official_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Phase Ib Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Multiple Dosing of XW003 Injection in Chinese Adolescents With Obesity

primary_outcomes.measure: Number and severity of adverse events
